run_random_masking: run random_masking on a batch of sequence tensors with a given mask ratio
run_random_masking_2d: run random_masking_2d on patch tensors with separate height and width masking ratios
create_masked_patches: create masked patches from a sequence tensor by randomly removing a fraction of tokens
build_maemasking: build a masked autoencoder masking module that returns masked tokens, binary mask, and restore indices
review_RandomMaskingOutput: review the RandomMaskingOutput NamedTuple that holds masked tensor, binary mask, and shuffle indices
